senses.gloss:
रोक रोक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. रुच्), light,
lustre, brightness, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VI.
66, 6 = दीप्ति, ‘light,’ or बाधक, ‘obstructing’);
buying with ready money; (अम्), n. a hole, cavity; a
boat, ship; moving, shaking; = कृपण-भेद.

रोकस्, अस्, n., Ved. light or any phenomenon of
light.
